_about: What grows in and round the farm pond (2026-11-18, the user: the farm pond looked plain; reeds, irises and lily pads give it a country pond's look of its own, unlike the temple's clipped garden). Rules: PondPlantRules; pictures: PondPlantArt (PlaceholderArt pondplant:<kind>:<stage>:<variant>); drawn by PondPlantLayer in 3D and FarmView in the flat view. `ponds`: by map, the spots (cells, x / y) hand-placed on the pond's own shape, the reeds on the far (north-east) and east banks so none hides the water from the camera (PondShape.of_farm): `reed` and `iris` clumps stand in the shallows on the bank's slope (the field between `bank` [min, max]), `lily` pads lie out over the flat bed (PondShape.on_bed); none by the farmer's fishing spot (`clear`: a cell centre and a radius, cells), so the bobber stays in sight. `seasons`: each kind's stage by season (none: not there), and the days of a season the irises flower (`bloom`) and some pads carry a flower (`flower`: the variants that do). Balance numbers are ours.
